tradeoff_findings: On Query Relevance, S6 outperforms S1 (LLM generates fluid, question-targeted responses whereas S1's template dumps raw record fields). On Information Completeness, S1 achieves near-perfect scores because the template exhausts all available record fields, whereas S6 occasionally elides secondary notes or quotes. Overall Quality Scores are closely comparable, confirming the paper's core thesis: deterministic formatting trades synthesis fluency for guaranteed citation validity and zero ungrounded claims.
